sourceEvidence.title: Site Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience **or** an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years of experience
* 3+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment
* 1+ years experience with quality standards and regulatory requirements such as ISO 9001 and AS9100
* 1+ years experience with ISO 9001 and AS9100 audits
* Prior leadership experience with direct and indirect reports
